question.prompt: What authoritative oracle should define which 'standard Airbnb filters' are in scope and what result-set predicate each one must enforce?

options.label: Defer exact predicates
options.detail: Treat exact filter-family semantics as unresolved in this run; do not claim a precise per-filter oracle until an authoritative filter-definition source is available.

options.label: Assume production behavior
options.detail: Use the current live Airbnb results behavior as the test oracle for whichever filters are visible during execution.

options.label: Single representative filter
options.detail: Assume one visible filter family is enough to stand in for all standard filters.

content.risk_rationale: Filter correctness is the core user value of this use-case, but the corpus does not define the authoritative filter catalog or the observable predicate for each filter family.

question.prompt: What documented interaction should count as 'location-based refinement' in map view for this story?

options.label: Defer exact interaction
options.detail: Treat the map-refinement interaction as unresolved in this run and limit exact assurance to map visibility for the current search until a source defines the interaction.

options.label: Assume viewport refine
options.detail: Assume moving the map and refreshing the visible area is the intended location-based refinement behavior.

options.label: Assume marker refine
options.detail: Assume selecting a map marker alone satisfies the location-based refinement promise.

content.risk_rationale: The PRD promises location-based refinement, but the corpus does not specify the gesture, control, or expected results change that proves it.

question.prompt: What baseline should define the 'existing filter types' this story must preserve?

options.label: Defer comparison
options.detail: Treat the preserved filter inventory as unresolved in this run until a baseline source or snapshot defines which filter types already existed.

options.label: Assume current production
options.detail: Use the current live results page as the baseline set of filter types.

options.label: Drop inventory check
options.detail: Treat filter inventory preservation as out of scope for assurance and verify only that the Filters control exists.

content.risk_rationale: The non-goal forbids adding filter types, but the corpus does not enumerate the pre-story filter inventory needed for a comparison oracle.

question.prompt: What baseline ordering should define whether existing filters were reordered?

options.label: Defer comparison
options.detail: Treat filter-order preservation as unresolved in this run until a baseline source or snapshot defines the prior order.

options.label: Assume current production
options.detail: Use the current live results page ordering as the baseline filter order.

options.label: Drop order check
options.detail: Treat filter-order preservation as out of scope for assurance and do not compare ordering in this run.

content.risk_rationale: The PRD forbids reordering filters, but the corpus does not supply the baseline ordering required for an authoritative oracle.

question.prompt: What homepage URL should runnable web tests open as their first step?

options.label: Use placeholder
options.detail: Author web tests with {{start_url}} as the homepage entry point until an exact URL or variable name is supplied.

options.label: Assume domain only
options.detail: Treat the literal airbnb.co.in domain named in the PRD as sufficient and fill the exact URL during execution.

options.label: Skip runnable tests
options.detail: Do not author runnable web tests until the exact homepage URL is supplied.

content.risk_rationale: Web tests cannot run from an invented entry URL, and the corpus names the homepage domain but not the exact starting URL string.

judgements.rationale: [risk_factors] Applied user-reach to all acceptance criteria because guest-facing search refinement affects a broad set of users on a primary discovery flow. Applied change-frequency to all acceptance criteria because results-page refinement controls and interaction details are likely to evolve. Did not apply money, auth, or data-loss because this use-case does not move money, gate access, or commit durable user data.
